test_json_parsable: test that valid JSON strings are recognized as parsable by an IncrementalTokenRecognizer with a JSON EBNF grammar
test_balanced_parentheses: test that deeply nested balanced parentheses are recognized correctly by an IncrementalTokenRecognizer with a balanced parentheses grammar
test_forcing_sequence: test that a hardcoded string literal grammar forces exact token sequences via IncrementalTokenRecognizer
test_emoji: test that emoji characters are accepted by an IncrementalTokenRecognizer using accept_token_ids with an emoji grammar
get_tokenizer: create a pretrained tokenizer instance from the tokenizer class using from_pretrained with use_fast option
